payload.diagnosis: Root-caused, not blamed on either commit (neither touches price-pipeline code). Test AC-1 (and by the same mechanism AC-13) generates synthetic OHLCV fixture data via unseeded Math.random(): basePrice = 100 + Math.random()*20, low = basePrice - 1 (apps/mcp-server/src/domain/services/priceBackfillService.ts fetchOhlcvData(), line ~217). When basePrice lands in [100,101) (~5% chance per generated row), low falls below the production STOCK_MIN_VND=100 floor (apps/mcp-server/src/domain/services/market-data/ohlcvUnitGuard.ts:24), causing validateOhlcvUnit to guard-reject that row before it reaches the INSERT OR IGNORE statement. AC-1's assertion expect(result.rowsSkipped).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1) depends on the ONE row matching the pre-seeded duplicate date (2026-03-27, one of only 3 weekday draws in the test's 5-day range) successfully reaching that INSERT — a ~5% per-run chance of guard-rejection instead flakes this specific assertion. Confirmed via local repro (3/3 clean, consistent with ~95% pass rate) plus direct code read of both the fixture generator and the production guard's exact floor logic (mag = Math.max(...) in normalizeOhlcvToVnd does NOT trip on this — it is the separate per-field validateOhlcvUnit range check that does).
payload.suggested_fix: Either seed the RNG deterministically for this test file, or shift the synthetic price floor comfortably away from STOCK_MIN_VND (e.g. basePrice = 200 + Math.random()*20 instead of 100 + ...), or mock/bypass normalizeOhlcvToVnd+validateOhlcvUnit for this dedup/backfill-logic test since it is not testing guard behavior. Test-file-only fix, no production code change, no rebuild required.
payload.verification_gate: targeted test file green across >=20 consecutive local runs after fix (probabilistic flake — single-run green is not sufficient proof)
